method: Bounded ghidra-cli decompilation and instruction listings from the identified analyzed program. The executable byte size and SHA-256 were verified, and program summary matched its name, image base and x86 little-endian 32-bit language. Decisive instruction listings used explicit project and program selection. The two named vtable cells were mapped through the authenticated PE section table. Addresses are absolute virtual addresses. Current Ghidra FileBytes and loaded-image contents were not freshly compared with the executable.
scope: Static WorldMaster._getServerTime native Lua receiver, argument and return contract. Positions count post-receiver arguments. The referenced cast-clock record owns clock-domain and cache-update evidence. This contract does not establish host timing behavior.

framework.invocation: 0x00D19B70 retrieves Lua stack index 1 and invokes the holder. It calls the common argument marshaller 0x00D19A20 at 0x00D19C16.

intOperator.signedConversion: FILD dword at 0x00CF99FA, FSTP double at 0x00CF9A03

receiver.failure: The adapter returns false when the native cast fails. The generic invocation raises a Lua error on a false holder result.

rows.extraArguments: The common marshaller starts at Lua stack index 2 and raises on any value beyond the empty declared list, including an extra nil argument.
rows.behavior: Reads the cached dword at native WorldMaster+0x60, constructs one internal tag-0 value through 0x00583D90 and appends it through 0x00584EE0. The int return operator interprets it as signed 32-bit and emits one Lua number. The callback reads no post-receiver argument, performs no post-receiver coercion and requests no yield.

limitations: Static client observations. No live Lua call or retail-client walk was performed.
No packet timing, clock rate, host clock source, host initialization or synchronization policy is established.
The scope excludes the Lua _inl descriptor to _cpp name mapping.
The scope excludes the classification of Lua values that fail the initial receiver lookup.
